source: TBDY 2018: SS and S1 (DD-2, 10 % in 50 years) of each city are example readings near its centre (uncertain, VERIFY.md T1); the AFAD map gives them by coordinates and they vary strongly within a city: enter the site's values under Site > Mapped spectral values (the project's values win over the town's). TL = 6 s (TBDY 2.3.4). The wind speed is a placeholder of the base pack's ASCE 7 method (TS 498 gives the wind as pressures by height, VERIFY.md T2).
